company.shortDescription: Cenomi Centers operates and develops lifestyle shopping centers and malls across Saudi Arabia.
company.description: Cenomi Centers operates and develops lifestyle shopping centers and malls across Saudi Arabia. The company owns and manages a portfolio of retail destinations that combine shopping, dining, and entertainment. Its centers host thousands of stores and brands and serve as community hubs with high annual visitor traffic. Cenomi Centers also offers leasing options, temporary retail programs, and brand activation and advertising opportunities for retailers and commercial partners. The company supports its visitors and tenants through the Cenomi Plus mobile app, which provides mall information, offers, events, and interactive navigation.
